Most of your agent's bill is scaffolding.
It answers before the call is made.

Limen sits between a terminal coding agent and its model API and decides, before the request leaves the machine, which tool schemas and which stale turns the call does not need. 43.6% fewer input tokens on measured traffic, task pass-rate held, running locally at $0.

python 3.9+, zero dependencies

Three routes. All of them run offline.

No key, no account, no GPU. The proxy answers from a heuristic the first second you start it; the local checkpoint is an upgrade you opt into later.

pip install subproto

From the index

The route the README's first code block uses. 0.1.0 is published: one console script, zero runtime dependencies, Python ≥ 3.9.

$pip install subproto
install.sh

From source

Builds a wheel from the clone and puts a subproto shim on your PATH. This is what you want if you mean to read the tests.

$git clone https://github.com/aashish254/limen && cd limen && ./install.sh
subproto demo

See it decide

Seventeen synthetic agent requests through the proxy, no upstream, no spend. Start here. --home on both lines, or the report reads a different directory than the one the demo wrote.

$subproto demo --slots --home /tmp/subproto-try && subproto report --home /tmp/subproto-try

Then subproto doctor — it reads this machine and tells you what is present, what is optional, and what to install. It names key variables and never a key. Gated on 3.9 and 3.11; this run was 3.11.15 on a Darwin 27.0.0, 10 cores at load 6.2.

subproto/config.py

What each slot answers, and what it would save.

None of them is on until you name it in SUBPROTO_APPLY, and each is reversible on its own. The token column is the offline projection.

slotwhat it decidestokens it would cut% of input
tool_gatewhich tool schemas this turn cannot use, out of the ~24 that ride along in every request101,56228.3%
compactwhich old turns have gone stale — a superseded tool result, an error the agent already worked around14,8214.1%
contextwhich file notes the code graph says this task will not touch00.0%
efforthow much reasoning this step deserves — advisory: it names a tier and never rewrites the request00.0%

A projection from measured prompt shapes — tokens that would not be sent, priced by the estimator the proxy itself uses. It is not a provider invoice, and the page does not present it as one.

docs/assets/figures/

Eight plates from the run.

Each figure carries the command that produced it, the host it ran on and the commit it came out of. Order is the argument: what a request carries, what comes off, whether the task still passes, and where the naive version breaks.

The average request before anything is decided: a fifth of it is tool schemas the turn cannot use, and the task itself is a rounding error.

python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 on Darwin 27.0.0, 20 tasks × 5 repeats, commit 0f7a546.

Input tokens per task with the layer off, per-slot, and compiled, split by what the task is about. The reduction is flat across families, which is the point — it is not one kind of task paying for the others.

python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 on Darwin 27.0.0, 20 tasks × 5 repeats, commit 0f7a546.

The same three arms grouped by the size of the unmanaged request. Bigger requests do not get a proportionally bigger cut, so the saving does not live only in the outliers.

python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 on Darwin 27.0.0, 20 tasks × 5 repeats, commit 0f7a546.

The ablation's own corpus: what each slot would take off a request shaped like the ones it measures, priced in estimated input tokens. That is why it is not the number the arms above delivered.

python3 bench/ab.py --mock 24 --json, run by python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 — 30 requests, 359,259 est input tokens.

Pass-rate by family with the cut enforced. A saving that broke the task would be visible here as a missing bar, not as a footnote.

python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 on Darwin 27.0.0, 20 tasks × 5 repeats, commit 0f7a546.

Of the files a task is about, how many survive (recall), and of what survives, how many are the ones that matter (precision). Per-slot keeps recall and spends precision; the compiler moves both.

python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 on Darwin 27.0.0, 20 tasks × 5 repeats, commit 0f7a546.

Eight tasks built so the file the grader wants sits behind a run of large files it does not need — which is what a per-slot recency budget is worst at. Per-slot loses every one of them. This panel is the reason the compiler is the default story rather than a bonus arm.

python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 on Darwin 27.0.0, 20 tasks × 5 repeats, commit 0f7a546.

The real small model's measured cost per decision against the shape it has to answer in. One shape fits the budget; the one that would name every option does not, so the shipped path scores a single choice.

convaiinnovations/laya 0.3.20 on cpu, read from bench/laya_latency.json — measured against the local server, not re-run by the arms.

regret_leg() in bench/launch_stats.py

Enforcing a wrong call bills the token back.

The saving has a price and it sits on this page beside it. A cut that drops a file the agent then reads again costs more than it saved.

17 of the 17 requests that carried a decision still had their body on disk when the harvest ran, which is what lets the payback be counted rather than estimated.

python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 on Darwin 27.0.0 — 17 demo requests replayed with the slots enforcing, bodies stored, commit 0f7a546.

The demo corpus is 17 requests and every one of them carries a decision. The regret harvest looks for the case where the wire disagrees with a cut — a file the slot dropped that the agent then read again — and it saw 14 evicted reads, of which 10 were wrong: the file came back on the next turn, so the cut cost 4,088 tokens of refetch instead of saving them. All 10 were enforced and none was shadow, so that is the price of a call made, not of a call observed — which is why Limen starts in observation, why each slot is reversible on its own, and why this bill sits on the page beside the saving. It works out at 588.2 regrettable drops per 1,000 requests. The mechanism still nets out at 43.6% fewer input tokens per task with the pass-rate held; the honest number is the pair, not the one that flatters it.

TODO.md, six open items

What this page refuses to claim.

Six claims a proxy like this is expected to make. Limen does not make them, because nothing in the repo has earned them yet. Each row is an open item in TODO.md; if one gets closed, the build fails until this table is edited on purpose.

the claimwhat it would take
−X% on your own traffica real agent session across ≥2 vendors, run by you. Nothing here has seen a human conversation; every number on this page comes from a seeded synthetic corpus.
the billed hero numberan approved API budget and a public 20-task SWE-bench-shaped set with a grader. The $ figures on this page are the in-repo mock's own tariff.
that a fine-tune beats the heuristiclabels. The published ablation says the real checkpoint loses by −0.083 precision on the corpus we carry, and 7 of its 10 cases have gold sets equal to the heuristic's own answer.
a shipped routing modelthe same labels, plus a training run and a weights release.
version 1.0the launch post, and the traffic that would earn the number. `0.1.0` is tagged and on PyPI, so `pip install subproto` is a route today; 1.0 is a claim about real sessions, not about a version string.
that it works on Windows`os.getloadavg` is POSIX and ANSI handling differs, so CI runs Windows and reports it without gating on it.
tools/make_site.py

17 subcommands. Every number re-derived.

Nothing on this page was typed by hand. The build replays the demo, reads the bench output, counts the tests and the mutants out of the source, and stops rather than print a figure it cannot find in the run.

python3 bench/launch_stats.py --iters 5 runs both arms, the regret harvest and the checkpoint curve, then writes the JSON and the eight plates beside it.
python3 tools/make_site.py replays the demo twice, renders this file, and fails on any token it has no value for.
bash run_tests.sh 442 tests and 157 mutants on 3.9 and 3.11 before any of it is committed.
